description: Pure domain core in src/lib + types: domain types, method catalog, the recommendation engine (RESOLVES design-review MEDIUM Finding 1), timer/stage/stats/time math, notifications wrapper, centralized Indonesian copy, and the full Vitest self-check suite. This is the framework-free heart of the app; depends only on FEAT-001. All modules are pure/typed with no React, no DOM, no Date.now() inside pure functions (now is injected). Grounded in design.md Sections 4, 5, 6, 7, 10, 11, 17, 19 and requirements AC5/AC6/AC10/AC13.
steps: Create src/types/index.ts EXACTLY per design Section 4: Goal, Intensity, IconKey (full key union incl. tab_*, play/stop/edit, stage_*, notifications, theme_*, plans, goal, trash, about, refresh, chevron, check, arrow_forward, exercise), MethodId ('14:10'|'16:8'|'18:6'|'20:4'|'omad'|'custom'), MethodMeta, ProfilingAnswers (exercises:boolean, intensity:Intensity|null, optional lastMealHour/wakeHour), Recommendation (method never custom/5:2, rationale non-empty, warning string|null, alternatives MethodId[]), FastingSessionRecord.

Create src/lib/cn.ts (className merge helper) and src/lib/methods.ts per Section 5: METHODS: Record<MethodId,MethodMeta> and METHOD_ORDER=['14:10','16:8','18:6','20:4','omad','custom']; fastingHours 14/16/18/20/23 and custom default 16; eatingHours=24-fasting; advanced true for 20:4 and omad; emoji-free Gojek taglines; 5:2 NOT in catalog.

Create src/lib/copy.ts per Section 17: typed object of all Indonesian Gojek-voice strings (zero emoji) for recommendation rationales/warnings, stages, toasts, notification bodies, empty/loading states, onboarding, settings; plus GOAL_LABELS: Record<Goal,string> per Section 10.

Create src/lib/recommendation.ts per Section 6. Pure recommendMethod(answers): ProfilingAnswers -> Recommendation. Early guard: if (answers.exercises && answers.intensity === 'heavy') return the R1 heavy result (method '14:10', non-null warning). Total classifier exerciseState(a): returns 'none' when !a.exercises || a.intensity===null, else a.intensity ('light'|'moderate'). switch(answers.goal) with a case per Goal, closed by default { const _exhaustive: never = answers.goal; return GENTLE_16_8; } (compile-time exhaustiveness). Implement the full decision table R1-R16 returning the exact method AND the exact alternatives arrays listed in Section 6.2.

RESOLVE Finding 1 (MEDIUM) in src/lib/recommendation.ts: encode the aggressive-method invariant EXACTLY as `const canOfferAggressive = answers.goal === 'weight_loss' && (exerciseState(answers) === 'none' || exerciseState(answers) === 'light');`. 20:4 and omad may appear in `alternatives` ONLY when canOfferAggressive is true (rows R2/R3) and must NEVER be the recommended `method`; heavy exercisers always get method '14:10' + the explicit warning. Do NOT transcribe the malformed boolean prose from design Section 6.3.

Create src/lib/timer.ts per Section 7.1: TimerState { startMs, targetHours, nowMs }, TimerComputed { elapsedMs=max(0,now-start), targetMs=targetHours*3_600_000, remainingMs=max(0,target-elapsed), targetEndMs=start+target, progress=clamp(elapsed/target,0,1), isComplete=elapsed>=target }; computeTimer pure; formatHMS(ms) 'HH:MM:SS' with uncapped hours.

Create src/lib/stages.ts per Section 7.2: StageKey union, Stage { key,label,description,iconKey (IconKey from @/types), minHours, maxHours }, stageForElapsed(elapsedMs) with half-open bounds [0,4) Pencernaan, [4,12) Mulai bakar lemak, [12,16) Ketosis mulai, [16,24) Autophagy, [24,null) Deep fast; iconKeys stage_pencernaan/stage_bakar_lemak/stage_ketosis/stage_autophagy/stage_deep_fast; emoji-free descriptions from copy.ts.

Create src/lib/time.ts (date-fns formatting + day-grouping helpers) and src/lib/stats.ts per Section 10: totals(sessions) {totalFasts,totalHours,averageHours}; streaks(sessions,now) {current,longest} (any session that day counts; current allows a 1-day grace); weekly(sessions,now) 7 {dayKey,label,totalHours} using startOfDay/differenceInCalendarDays/format. now is injected.

Create src/lib/notifications.ts per Section 11: best-effort client-only isSupported/getPermission/requestPermission/scheduleEndReminder/scheduleStartReminder/clearScheduled; typed status; never throws to UI; dev-only console.warn on failure; bodies from copy.ts.
Create the Vitest suites in src/lib/__tests__/: recommendation.test.ts, timer.test.ts, stages.test.ts, stats.test.ts, methods.test.ts, no-emoji.test.ts (see acceptance criteria for exact coverage).
acceptance_criteria: `npx tsc --noEmit` passes with no type errors across src/lib and src/types.

recommendation.test.ts asserts all 16 decision rows (both the returned method AND the exact alternatives array per row), and iterates the full RAW input product of 5 goals x 5 (exercises,intensity) pairs = 25 inputs (including the degenerate exercises=true/intensity=null): method is never 'custom' and never any 5:2 value; every heavy input returns method '14:10' and warning !== null; every non-heavy input returns warning === null; 20:4/omad appear in alternatives ONLY when goal==='weight_loss' AND exerciseState is 'none'|'light', never elsewhere and never as method; rationale is a non-empty string; alternatives never contain the recommended method and have no duplicates.

recommendation.test.ts includes the degenerate-equivalence test: for every goal, recommendMethod({goal,exercises:true,intensity:null}) deep-equals recommendMethod({goal,exercises:false,intensity:null}).
stages.test.ts asserts boundaries at 3.99h, 4h, 11.99h, 12h, 15.99h, 16h, 23.99h, and 24h (24h -> Deep fast).

timer.test.ts covers computeTimer (incl. overfast elapsed>target with progress clamped at 1) and formatHMS incl. hours > 24 (e.g. 26:03:11); stats.test.ts covers streaks/totals/weekly with a fixed now; methods.test.ts covers fasting/eating hour math.
no-emoji.test.ts scans src against an emoji Unicode-range regex and fails on any match.
verification: Run `npx tsc --noEmit` and confirm no type errors.
Run `npx vitest run src/lib` and confirm every suite passes, including the 25-input invariant assertions and the no-emoji scan.
findings:
Pure domain core complete and verified: `npx tsc --noEmit` clean and `npx vitest run src/lib` = 101 tests across 6 suites all passing. Files created: src/types/index.ts (Goal/Intensity/IconKey full union/MethodId/MethodMeta/ProfilingAnswers/Recommendation/FastingSessionRecord), src/lib/cn.ts, src/lib/methods.ts (METHODS + METHOD_ORDER incl custom; fasting 14/16/18/20/23/16; advanced 20:4+omad; 5:2 excluded), src/lib/copy.ts (all Indonesian Gojek strings + GOAL_LABELS; single no-emoji audit surface), src/lib/recommendation.ts, src/lib/timer.ts, src/lib/stages.ts, src/lib/time.ts, src/lib/stats.ts, src/lib/notifications.ts, and tests in src/lib/__tests__/.

Finding 1 (MEDIUM) RESOLVED exactly as specified: canOfferAggressive = goal==='weight_loss' && (exerciseState==='none' || exerciseState==='light'). exerciseState collapses exercises:true/intensity:null -> 'none'. 20:4/omad appear only in R2/R3 alternatives ['18:6','20:4','omad'], never as method; heavy -> method '14:10' + non-null warning with alternatives ['16:8']. The malformed boolean prose from design 6.3 was NOT transcribed.

Contracts other steps rely on:
- recommendMethod(answers): ProfilingAnswers -> Recommendation; exported helpers exerciseState(a) and canOfferAggressive(a). switch(goal) closed by `const _exhaustive: never` default (marked /* v8 ignore next 2 */).
- Decision table R1-R16 implemented verbatim per design 6.2 (methods AND exact alternatives arrays); verified row-by-row + 25-raw-input invariant sweep + degenerate-equivalence (exercises:true/null deep-equals exercises:false/null per goal).
- timer.ts: computeTimer(TimerState)->TimerComputed (elapsed clamped>=0, progress clamped[0,1], isComplete elapsed>=target), formatHMS(ms) 'HH:MM:SS' uncapped hours (now injected, no Date.now in pure fns).
- stages.ts: StageKey/Stage/stageForElapsed with half-open [min,max); 24h -> Deep fast. STAGE_LIST exported. iconKeys stage_pencernaan/stage_bakar_lemak/stage_ketosis/stage_autophagy/stage_deep_fast.
- stats.ts: totals/streaks(now injected, 1-day grace)/weekly (7 buckets oldest->newest, now injected). time.ts: formatClock/formatDate/dayKey/weekdayLabel via date-fns.
- notifications.ts: isSupported/getPermission/requestPermission/scheduleEndReminder/scheduleStartReminder/clearScheduled; typed PermissionStatus + ScheduleStatus; never throws to UI; dev-only console.warn.
- copy.ts shape: copy.methodTaglines (Record<MethodId,string>), copy.recommendation.*, copy.stages.*, copy.toasts.*, copy.notifications.*, copy.states.*, copy.onboarding.*, copy.settings.*; GOAL_LABELS: Record<Goal,string>.

Note for later FEATs: the no-emoji scan test (src/lib/__tests__/no-emoji.test.ts) walks the whole src/ tree per-file (.ts/.tsx/.css/.mjs/.js), so any emoji added in later features will fail this suite.
